title: Prostate Cancer IMAGing IN Early Detection (IMAGINED Trial)
official: Validation, Calibration, and Translation of Restriction Spectrum Imaging Signal Maps to Enhance MRI Diagnostic Capabilities in Prostate Cancer
summary: The researchers hope to learn if specific types of MRI software and techniques can help improve early prostate cancer detection at time of a MRI-guided prostate biopsy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Selected to undergo an MRI-fusion prostate needle biopsy of the prostate.
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* prior diagnosis of prostate cancer (Grade Group \>1)
* metastatic prostate cancer
* prior prostate cancer treatment
* contraindication to prostate biopsy (e.g., on anticoagulation that cannot be safely discontinued)
* inability to undergo MRI (e.g., too large to be accommodated in a scanner or with an implant incompatible with MRI).
* Bilateral hip replacement
* Unable to provide informed consent.
